violation_type.title: Child Becomes Ill in Care and Requires Immediate Treatment or Hospitalization - First Aid and CPR (26 TAC §746.3605(b)(2))
violation_type.short_title: Child Becomes Ill in Care and Requires Immediate Treatment or Hospitalization - First Aid and CPR
violation_type.typical_finding: During a DFPS investigation, it was discovered a caregiver did not provide first aid to an injured child.

finding_variants.text: During a DFPS investigation, it was discovered a caregiver did not provide first aid to an injured child.
A caregiver failed to immediately provide CPR to unresponsive child.
This standard was found deficient as part of the DFPS investigation. It was determined that a caregiver did not provide first aid to a child who sustained an injury that required medical attention.
This standard was reviewed in relation to the reported allegation and found to be deficient. It was observed the caregivers did not provide first aid to a bite injury.
